question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word:** Hegemony**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Subordination**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **“Hegemony”** means dominance or leadership, especially by one state or group over others. (प्रभुत्व या आधिपत्य)

 
• **Example:** The country's cultural hegemony was evident in its influence over neighboring nations.

• **“Subordination”** refers to the act of placing someone or something in a lower rank or position, opposing the concept of dominance. (आधीनता)

 
• **Example:** His subordination to his superior was evident in his work ethic and obedience.

• H
